# Infinora Dental Care — Clinical & Organizational Knowledge Base

## 1. Clinic Entity & Core Authority

- **Practice Name:** Infinora Dental Care
- **Founder & Lead Clinician:** Dr. Riddhi Patel Shah
- **Primary Specialist Qualification:** Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) in Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics

- **Post-Graduate Recognition:** University Rank-Holder in MDS (Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics)

---

## 4. Clinical Scope & Treatment Disciplines

All treatments are planned following an individualized clinical evaluation; outcomes and timelines vary per patient.

- **Orthodontics & Smile Alignment:** Braces (metal, ceramic, self-ligating), clear aligners, Invisalign, invisible aligners, early orthodontic evaluations for children/teens, and smile improvement / smile design consultations led by Dr. Riddhi Patel Shah (MDS Orthodontics).
- **Restorative & Endodontic Care:** Root canal treatment (RCT), tooth-colored fillings, crowns, bridges, and bonding.
- **Tooth Replacement & Aesthetics:** Dental implant consultations, veneers, and teeth whitening.
- **Preventive, Gum & Oral Surgery Care:** Routine dental checkups, teeth cleaning/scaling, gum care, tooth/wisdom tooth extractions, and pediatric/family dental visits.
- **Teleconsultation & NRI Coordination:** Initial online video/teleconsultation options for outstation patients across India and visiting NRIs prior to in-clinic visits.

---

## 5. Hygiene, Diagnostics & Patient Comfort

- **Diagnostics:** Clinical examination supported by digital imaging/X-rays and optical scans as indicated.
- **Hygiene & Sterilization:** Structured instrument cleaning, pouching, and sterilization protocols between patient visits.
- **Payment Options:** Cash, UPI, Google Pay, Debit/Credit Cards, Mobile NFC, and payment/EMI options where applicable.

---

## 6. School, Corporate & Community Outreach

- **Schools & Colleges:** Preventive oral health awareness and dental checkup guidance for students.
- **Corporate Wellness:** Preventive dental talks and oral health checkup support for workplace teams.
- **Community & Social Initiatives:** Oral health awareness and screening support with local community groups and welfare organizations in Western Mumbai.

  A: Patients can enquire about dental checkups, teeth cleaning, braces, clear aligners, Invisalign, invisible aligners, early orthodontic evaluations, smile improvement, root canal treatment, crowns, dental implants, veneers, gum care, extractions, and family dentistry.
